source.title: Irish News, 24 October 1987, p. 1 ("Adams salutes SF poll win (results for Lower and Upper Falls)"); Andersonstown News, 3 October 1987, p. 12 ("Eleven Fight for Vacant Seats (candidate lists, poll date 22 October)"); Irish News, 22 August 1987, p. 1 ("Council election date set (by-elections fixed for 22 October after co-option bid failed)"); Irish Press, 18 July 1987, p. 4 ("Husband and wife team quit council (Glendinning resignations)")
source.publisher: Irish News / Andersonstown News / Irish Press (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Quota 4,264 = floor(8,527/2)+1, consistent with the reported valid poll. The five first preferences as printed sum to 8,526, one short of the reported 8,527, so one printed figure is out by one. Reported majority 3,507 = 5,425 - 1,918. Elected on the first count.

note: By-election of 22 October 1987 for one seat in Lower Falls (Belfast), caused by the resignation of Will Glendinning (Alliance), announced c. 17 July 1987 together with his wife Pip Glendinning (Upper Falls), for personal reasons.

countGroup.Party_Basis: Printed 'Labour' by the Irish News; Michael Duffy stood for the Labour and Trade Union Group in Upper Falls the same day, and An Phoblacht's reprint of the count prints Officer as Labour & TUG
